nom: Neutrogena Alcohol-Free Gentle Daily Facial Toner

avis.texte: I was hesitant to try this toner as I’m 73 years old. I was concerned it would dry out my skin. I’m glad I took a chance. It’s incredible for the price. Doesn’t dry out my skin and leaves my face looking clean and healthy.
Perfect toner. Removes the last traces of makeup after your makeup remover. No odor and bottle lasts a long time.

The product itself is great. Gentle on dry and sensitive skin. I wish that the packaging came with a safety seal underneath the cap or that it was shipped with tape over the cap to prevent spills when shipped. I subscribe and save this product and every month it is thrown in with food and other items that would be damaged if the cap broke inside the shipping box. Some extra care for packaging to ship this product is needed.
This is truly great at cleaning your face and feeling refreshed.
Always my go-to toner. Alcohol free so no less stimulating to my skin. I don't think I need anything more high-end cosmetic than this. Does its job and good.
I have sensitive skin and this works great for me and doesn't dry my skin

avis.titre: Burning sensation and I do not have sensitive skin
avis.texte: Not sure why such a simple ingredient causes such burn on my skin. Product were not seal. Had to stop using. Disappointed

Although I’m generally quite happy with the Neutrogena brand, this toner absolutely burned my face after the very first application. Unfortunately, I felt compelled to leave this review to help prevent others from experiencing the same reaction.

avis.titre: Tónico suave y efectivo para pieles sensibles ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
avis.texte: e estado usando este tónico de Neutrogena durante unas semanas y estoy muy impresionada. Es increíblemente suave para mi piel sensible y no me causa irritación ni sequedad. Lo uso después de la limpieza y noto cómo elimina los restos de suciedad y maquillaje, dejando mi piel fresca y equilibrada. Me encanta que no contenga alcohol, ya que esto ayuda a mantener la barrera natural de la piel intacta. Además, tiene un aroma sutil y agradable. Definitivamente, seguiré usando este tónico en mi rutina diaria de cuidado de la piel. ¡Altamente recomendado para cualquiera que busque un tónico suave y eficaz!

I have been using this toner for about a month, and it's amazing! I use it after washing my face with the Ultra Gentle Daily Cleanser and I also use it after removing facial hair off my face! It leaves my skin so fresh and clean! I have combination skin, so this product for perfect for me! Most toners that I used in the past would burn my skin. What I love about the Neutrogena Toner is that it's fragrance free and alcohol free! It doesn't burn or dries out my skin! This helps my pores stay open and allowing my skin to breathe! This is my 1st time buying this toner, and I'm so glad that I did! The perfect product to add to my skincare routine! I will definitely buy it again! Highly recommend it 👌🏾☺️💙

The product is great. I use it daily. But the shipping cost me some of the product when one of the bottles was open. Usually they are shipped with a shrink wrap cover over the lid. These were not and you can see the results. Full bottle in the right and the one that was open on the left!

Neutrogena is always a trusted brand for sensitive skin. If you are looking for a no frills, no fuss, gentle toner, look no further. It is fragrance free and does not tingle on skin. When I tested it, I used a cotton pad to apply it and it almost felt like I was using water. Except the evidence that it was cleansing my skin better than water alone was apparent on the pad. My skin did not feel tight afterward or as though there was any product residue. It didn't dry out my skin or cause any irritation whatsoever.

I have been using a Neutrogena alcohol-free toner for about 20 years and was a bit worried at first when I found out Neutrogena stopped making it. This new toner provides good moisture and always leaves my skin feeling great. It works just as well as the previous version (blue bottle). The new one also has a completely different formulation with fewer ingredients and lacks any smell. I highly recommend this toner.
I have use this product before. Second time purchasing and it works really well on my skin
I love this product, it's truly amazing. Would recommend it to everybody!! Get yours now!!

avis.titre: Cleans off extra oils even after cleansing
avis.texte: It’s crazy what still comes off of your skin even after you’ve just cleaned it. The photo of the pad was using this toner about 10-15 minutes after I had just cleaned my face with my typical cleanser. The toner looks and has the consistency of alcohol but it’s alcohol free! That means it’s not supposed to dry out your face and it tones it for whatever the next step is in your routine. Some days I just go about my day after applying this toner and other times I’ll wait until my skin relaxes and then go on with my makeup routine. This has helped clear out my pores and make them more even to apply makeup. It has no fragrance and doesn’t have any kind of reaction on my skin. It doesn’t burn, make my skin tight, or dry it out. Honestly, I have incredibly oily skin and I had hoped that it would dry out my skin a little! It’s really easy to use I just apply it to a cotton pad as shown and a little goes a long way since it doesn’t evaporate like alcohol would.
The packaging looked a bit shady, as if it had been opened and returned, then sent to me. I really like Neutrogena products but I’m a bit wary of the company who sent this.

This Neutrogena Alcohol-Free Gentle Daily Facial Toner is a very affordable option. The toner comes in an 8oz bottle. It’s alcohol free so you won’t get a dry feeling after using it. I like that it doesn’t have a really strong smell. My skin feels refreshed after using the toner and it doesn’t leave any sort of residue. I’d recommend giving this toner a try as it gives you similar results to some of the more expensive ones on the market at a fraction of the price.

avis.titre: Tones skin an perfect for sensitive skin
avis.texte: You can add this to your daily routine after washing your face use this then add a moisturizer an your done, i use this daily an my face tone has evened out an isnt as spotty as it was. An its the full size bottle, i use a makeup rag but im switching to cotton wipes.definitly reccomend

avis.titre: Not the same product; might be tampered!!!
avis.texte: I have used this Neutrogena product for years. I have seen that it is now in a different bottle. The bottle I used to buy was blue. Like other customers have said, I received it without a factory seal on it and there was a piece of tape over it from the company stating "helps prevent liquid leaks". I tried it one time anyway and it is also burning my face. If it's alcohol-free it should not feel this way. The product that I have always used has never made my face burn. I think this is a mock version of the Neutrogena product. I will be returning and never buying from this company again!!!
Sadly I developed an allergic reation to this product after using for a few days

I am send this I am sending this back for the second time because I thought the first time that it came it was not sealed it was a mistake so I ordered it for the second time and it came back again not sealed so therefore I will send it back again a second time.

False advertising! The description/images note this is a new packaging for the same tone, with the same ingredients. You can see in my picture with the ingredients, it is NOT the same. It also feels heavy and sticky on the face- not refreshingly clean. Sadly, I’ll have to find another toner 😢
Has no silver protective seal so I can only assume the product is no good.
